issues.issue: Whether the RPD's credibility findings (contradictions, loan agreement, repayment, documents) were erroneous
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in assessing his credibility on the reasons set out in the memorandum.
issues.result_quote: I conclude that the appellant failed to establish that the RPD committed errors that would justify the RAD setting aside the determination.

issues.issue: Whether the two handwritten support letters (ex-wife and neighbour) should be admitted as new evidence
issues.applicant_position: The two letters should be admitted as new evidence under s. 110(4) IRPA.
issues.result_quote: I do not accept these two documents as evidence because I find that they do not meet the test for credibility.
